headlines.title: Map: Track the spread of measles in the U.S.
headlines.description: NBC News is tracking confirmed measles case counts and state infection tallies. This data will be updated regularly.

headlines.title: MAHA fractures deepen as some RFK Jr. followers turn into harsh critics
headlines.description: A scorecard from MAHA activists suggests the Trump administration has broken most of its promises to the movement. The “burn feels especially raw,” one prominent activist said.

headlines.title: FDA plans to update nutritional rules for infant formula
headlines.description: The Food and Drug Administration plans to introduce new rules around what nutrients must be added to infant formula. The changes the FDA plans to propose, which were shared in advance with NBC News, would tweak the minimum and maximum levels of four nutrients: iodine, manganese, vitamin A and vitamin D.

headlines.title: Pat Croce Shares Lessons From ‘Enjoy Yourself Now!’
headlines.description: Pat Croce, the enthusiastic former president and co-owner of the Philadelphia 76ers who once climbed the Walt Whitman Bridge to hang the team’s banner, joins TODAY talk about his new book “Enjoy Yourself Now! 66 Sacred Shifts to Instantly Awaken the Peaceful Presence Within You.”

headlines.title: Clocks Change This Weekend: What You Can Do Now to Adjust
headlines.description: This weekend, Daylight Saving Time ends and even though we “fall back” and gain an extra hour, it can still mess with our body clocks. Dr. Mike Varshavski, board certified family medicine physician, joins TODAY to share ways to keep your sleep cycle on track.

headlines.title: Health Concerns Raised for Elementary School Near Data Centers
headlines.description: An elementary school in Loudoun County, Virginia is nearly surrounded by 11 data centers and community members are concerned about the pollution that be might produced and what their kids might be breathing. NBC’s Stephanie Gosk reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Kindle, Away, Ninja and Hoka dropped new products in October — here’s what we’re loving
headlines.description: Shopping experts tested new products from Samsung, Kindle, Hoka, Nutrafol, Oofos and more this month. These are brands’ best launches of October across categories.

headlines.title: Training for a 5K or marathon? These are the only running watches actually worth buying
headlines.description: I’ve tested dozens of running watches from Garmin, Coros, Amazfit, Fitbit, Apple and more. Here are my top picks for beginners, races and ultra-athletes alike.

headlines.title: BioSilk’s popular Silk Therapy Leave-In Treatment is 72% off today
headlines.description: BioSilk Silk Therapy Original leave-in treatment debuted in 1986, and shoppers still love it for shine and frizz. It’s currently 72% off on Amazon.

headlines.title: Parents are saying Millie Moon diapers caused bad rashes — here’s what you need to know.
headlines.description: Consumer Reports is urging parents to stop using Millie Moon diapers after 600-plus reports of infant skin reactions. Here’s what to know and what to do.

headlines.title: We Asked Dietitians Their Favorite Halloween Candy and This Was the No. 1 Brand
headlines.description: Candy can be part of a healthy diet — especially if it’s part of celebrating Halloween fun. Here’s how dietitians think about candy and their favorites to eat.

headlines.title: This Mason Jar Green Pea Salad Is Going Viral: A Dietitian’s Honest Review
headlines.description: Health and wellness influencer Raven Ross’ fiber-packed green pea and chicken salad is going viral on TikTok. A dietitian gives her honest review of the trend.
